title: Too much glue!!
text: Too much glue!!. This buisiness needs to tell the manufacturers they are wrecking the roses. Most of the roses are like this and I have to use tweezers to pick out the glue and the roses on their side, I'll try to rub it off, if I can't I'll paint them. Like the blue ones in the the picture with the red bow. I had to paint the outside to save them!

product_metadata.title: 24 Realistic Wooden Roses, Dark Pink and Purple
features: Beautiful Vibrant 2-inch rose buds with wire stem for arrangements. 13 inch total length.
Includes: 10 dark pink roses with purple tips, 14 dark pink roses that are bright and vibrant
Made of shaved birch wood; Never die, never need watering; Display in a vase, use in a centerpiece or bouquet
Great gift for any occasion! Weddings, Mother's Day, graduations, birthdays, Valentine's Day, recitals, and more!
Give each one separately as a gift or party favor, or use all of them together
description: Give the perfect gift for that special someone or a unique gift to a friend! With an overall length of 13 inches, these wood roses have all of the beauty of real flowers. Wired stem provides stability and flexibility for floral arrangements.
